```{r load-data, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

source(here("R", "00-config.R"))

# Load data

# Load results
```

```{r variograms-prep, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

plot_data <- variograms %>%
  transmute(district, marker, vgm) %>%
  unnest(vgm) %>%              # vgm is a data.frame-like object; this unnests bins
  as_tibble() %>%              # for ggplot convenience
  mutate(type = "empirical")

model_preds <- variograms %>%
  mutate(
    maxdist = cutoff,
    preds = pmap(
      list(fit, maxdist),
      function(fit, maxdist) {
        if (is.null(fit) || is.null(fit$fits) || !is.finite(maxdist) || maxdist <= 0) return(NULL)
        imap_dfr(fit$fits, function(fit_obj, key) {
          if (is.null(fit_obj)) return(NULL)
          gstat::variogramLine(fit_obj, maxdist = maxdist) %>%
            as_tibble() %>%
            mutate(model = key)
        })
      }
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!map_lgl(preds, is.null)) %>%
  dplyr::select(district, marker, preds) %>%
  unnest(preds)

range_df <- variograms %>%
  dplyr::select(district, marker, best_fit_name, best_range) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(best_fit_name, "\nrange = ", round(best_range / 1000, 1), " km")) %>%
  group_by(district, marker) %>%
  summarise(label = paste(label, collapse = "\n"),
            .groups = "drop")
```

```{r variograms-plot, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=7, fig.height=7}

variogram_plots_by_marker <- map(markers, function(marker_name) {
  
  pd <- plot_data %>% filter(marker == marker_name)
  mp <- model_preds %>% filter(marker == marker_name)
  
  p <- ggplot(pd, aes(x = dist / 1000, y = gamma)) +
    geom_point(size = 1.8, alpha = 0.6) +
    { if (nrow(mp) > 0)
      geom_line(data = mp, aes(x = dist / 1000, y = gamma, color = model),
                linewidth = 0.8)
    } +
    geom_text(
      data = range_df %>% filter(marker == marker_name),
      aes(
        x = Inf,
        y = Inf,
        label = label
      ),
      size = 2.6,
      hjust = 1,
      vjust = 1,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ district, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Empirical variograms + fitted curves:", marker_name),
      x = "Distance (km)",
      y = "Semivariance",
      linetype = NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      strip.text = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = number_format(accuracy = 0.01)) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 25))
  
  filename <- paste0("variograms_", marker_name, ".png")
  ggsave(here::here("figs", filename),
         p, width = 7, height = 7, units = "in", dpi = 300)
  
  message("Saved variogram plot for ", marker_name)
  p
})

variogram_plots_by_marker

```

```{r generate-spatial-predictions}
# Function to get predictions for one model
get_predictions_for_model <- function(dist, mrk, model, grid_data) {
  if(is.null(model)) return(NULL)
  
  study_grid <- grid_data %>%
    filter(district == dist) %>%
    pull(grid) %>%
    .[[1]]
  
  preds_sf <- tryCatch(
    get_grid_preds(study_grid, model),
    error = function(e) {
      warning(paste0("Prediction failed for ", district, " - ", mrk, ": ", e$message))
      return(NULL)
    }
  )
  
  if(is.null(preds_sf)) return(NULL)
  
  # Convert to raster then tibble
  preds_coords <- st_coordinates(preds_sf)
  
  pred_tibble <- tibble(
    x = preds_coords[,1],
    y = preds_coords[,2],
    value = preds_sf$pred,  # Convert to percentage
    district = dist,
    marker = mrk
  )
  
  return(pred_tibble)
}

# Get predictions for all models

spatial_models <- spatial_models %>%
  mutate(
    predictions = pmap(
      list(district, marker, spatial_model),
      ~get_predictions_for_model(..1, ..2, ..3, district_grids)
    )
  )

saveRDS(spatial_models, here("output", "rds", "spatial_models_with_predictions.rds"))

preds_all <- spatial_models %>%
  transmute(
    district,
    marker,
    predictions = map(predictions, ~ {
      if (is.null(.x)) {
        tibble(x = numeric(), y = numeric(), value = numeric())
      } else {
        .x %>% dplyr::select(x, y, value)
      }
    })
  ) %>%
  unnest(predictions)

```

```{r plot-prediction-layers}

make_marker_pred_patchwork <- function(marker,
                                       marker_label = marker,
                                       ncol = 4,
                                       limits = c(0, 1)) {

  plot_list <- map(district_order, function(dist) {

    # district boundary
    dist_shp <- districts_tib %>%
      filter(district == !!dist) %>%
      pull(district_shp)

    shp_dist <- amhara_shp %>%
      filter(adm3_name == dist_shp)

    # predictions for this district+marker
    pred_dist <- preds_all %>%
      filter(district == dist, marker == !!marker) %>%
      mutate(value = pmin(pmax(value, 0), 1))  # clamp to limits

    ggplot() +
      # raster layer if we have any preds
      { if (nrow(pred_dist) > 0)
          geom_raster(data = pred_dist, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = value), interpolate = FALSE)
      } +
      geom_sf(data = shp_dist, fill = NA, color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3) +
      scale_fill_viridis_c(limits = limits, name = "Predicted prevalence") +
      coord_sf() +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
      labs(title = dist, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
      theme(
        axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank()
      ) +
      ggspatial::annotation_scale(location = "br", width_hint = 0.3)
  })

  pred_plot <- wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = ncol) +
    plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
    plot_annotation(title = paste0("Predicted ", marker_label, " prevalence by district")) &
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  
  ggsave(
    pred_plot,
    here("output", "figs", paste0("prediction_maps_", marker, ".png")),
    width = 300, height = 200, units = "mm", dpi = 300
  )
  
  return(pred_plot)
}

marker_levels <- c("Pgp3", "TF", "PCR")
names(marker_levels) <- marker_levels  # labels = values

pred_patchworks <- imap(marker_levels, ~ make_marker_pred_patchwork(marker = .y, marker_label = .x))

pred_patchworks
```
